verdict.rationale: Twilio's MCP docs say its MCP server indexes 'public API specifications' covering more than 1,800 endpoints, which implies first-party machine-readable specs exist. The pack never names a format (OpenAPI or otherwise) or a download location. llms.txt and docs.md are machine-readable documentation, not an API spec, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: an explicit OpenAPI or equivalent spec format, a documented download URL or repository, versioning details, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec can be downloaded.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The MCP server indexes public API specifications only.
